say:1:1721929001:1.text: Aiden, do you know why Pearl disappeared without a word?
say:1:1721929001:1.source_cn: 阿德里安，你知道珍珠为何会不告而别吗？

say:3:1721929003:1.text: Because she got tired of those dreary little songs of yours, obviously! All that sniffling and sulking day in and day out... anyone would get fed up. Even a fish can only take so much!
say:3:1721929003:1.source_cn: 都是因为听腻了你那些苦哈哈的曲子！整天哭哭啼啼的，谁受...

say:4:1721929004:1.text: ... Is that really it? I thought she liked my sad songs...
say:4:1721929004:1.source_cn: 是……是这样吗？我还以为她喜欢我的悲伤……

say:5:1721929005:1.text: Liked them? No. She pitied you! And pity won't bring her back. If you want to draw her out again, you'll have to give her something she actually enjoys!
say:5:1721929005:1.source_cn: 哼，她那是同情你！想要引她出来，必须得来点不一样的！

say:6:1721929006:1.text: So here's what you're going to do. At <style="highlight">dusk</style>, when she's in her best mood, you're going to give her a real performance. And this time, no more sad songs. Play something bright, something cheerful enough to make the whole river dance!

say:7:1721929007:1.text: And that alone won't be enough. You'll need a gift for her too, and don't even think about bringing something ordinary. She wouldn't spare it a second glance.
say:7:1721929007:1.source_cn: 还有，别忘了见面礼。普通的东西她可看不上。

say:8:1721929008:1.text: Then... should I make her a little ornament? Some feathers, some twigs... something like that?
say:8:1721929008:1.source_cn: 那……我再去收集一些羽毛和树枝制作工艺品？

say:9:1721929009:1.text: No. Stop right there! That was for me. Pearl has different tastes!
say:9:1721929009:1.source_cn: 停！打住！那只是我私人的喜好！

say:10:1721929010:1.text: This time, you need to prepare <style="highlight">three pearls filled with happy memories</style>.
say:10:1721929010:1.source_cn: 这次我要你准备<style=highlight>三颗凝...

say:11:1721929011:1.text: Pearl is called Pearl for a reason. She loves pearl-like trinkets. And if those trinkets are filled with happy memories, that playful fool won't be able to resist coming up for a closer look. Got it?
say:11:1721929011:1.source_cn: 鱼如其名，珍珠最喜欢的东西就是漂亮的珠子。只有充满快乐...

choice_prompt:12:1721929011.text: Pearl is called Pearl for a reason. She loves pearl-like trinkets. And if those trinkets are filled with happy memories, that playful fool won't be able to resist coming up for a closer look. Got it?
choice_prompt:12:1721929011.source_cn: 鱼如其名，珍珠最喜欢的东西就是漂亮的珠子。只有充满快乐气息的珠子，才能把那个贪玩的家伙从水底勾引出来。懂了吗？

say:13:1721929012:1.text: Something round. Something bright. Something that brings a happy memory to Aiden's mind the moment he sees it. That's as much help as you're getting from me. Now go. You'll only get one chance to do this right!
say:13:1721929012:1.source_cn: 圆的、闪亮的、能让阿德里安想起开心事情的东西——我只能...

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 凝结了快乐回忆的珠子？
